source.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3
source.author: Michael
source.note: Fan-made model titled Gen 3 by its author; it resembles Gen 2 and is not Tesla CAD.

changes: Node rotation baked; single mesh cut into 17 parts at the joints; each part simplified with meshoptimizer (about 407k triangles total); textures re-encoded as WebP (2048 base colour, 1024 normal and metal/rough); geometry Draco-compressed. Pipeline: scripts/optimus-model-pipeline.mjs. The poster is a render of the processed model.
